description: Base 100-point rubric. AI returns a 0..1 evidence-backed fraction per criterion; points are computed by backend Python only.

criteria.name: Relevant skills
criteria.description: Technical and non-technical skills relevant to the preferred role, evidenced in the application or resume.
guidance: Credit demonstrated skills, not keyword lists.
Distinguish tool familiarity from applied use.
Ignore resume styling, layout and design quality.

criteria.name: Projects and practical experience
criteria.description: Depth, ownership and outcomes of projects, internships, freelance work or practical experience.
guidance: Look for the candidate's specific contribution and measurable outcomes.
Academic coursework alone is weaker evidence than shipped work.
Do not infer experience that is not described.

criteria.name: Role-specific knowledge
criteria.description: Understanding of the responsibilities and craft of the preferred role.
guidance: Assess against the role definition supplied in the prompt.
For leadership roles assess planning, delegation and accountability.
For creative roles assess craft evidence, not portfolio decoration.

criteria.name: Problem-solving
criteria.description: Evidence of diagnosing problems, making trade-offs and reaching outcomes.
guidance: Prefer concrete problem -> approach -> result examples.
Give credit for debugging, iteration and learning from failure.

criteria.name: Communication
criteria.description: Clarity and structure of written application answers and evidence of explaining work to others.
guidance: Assess clarity of the applicant's own words only.
Never penalise English spelling variants, disability or background.

criteria.name: Commitment and availability
criteria.description: Stated availability, consistency of commitment and understanding of the time requirement.
guidance: Use only stated availability and commitment information.
Do not assume availability from year of study or department.

criteria.name: Leadership and collaboration
criteria.description: Evidence of leading, coordinating or collaborating with others.
guidance: Distinguish formal titles from actual contribution.
Team projects count when the candidate's role is described.
